description: Accept a gift (with the delivery address, which goes only to Befana and the store selling the gift), decline it, or swap it for something of similar value from find_gifts with swap_for. save:"preview" (default) shows what will happen; save:"save" sends the answer. The sender sees only that it was accepted or declined, never the address.

address.description: Needed to accept or swap. US addresses only for now

option.description: Chosen product options by name, e.g. {"Size":"9"}; names and values come from find_gifts

save.description: preview (default) shows what would happen and keeps nothing; save does it. Only use save after the person said yes to the preview.

name: respond_to_gift
title: Answer a gift
